conceptual_change: Introduce a mean-reversion signal using a 50-period Z-Score of the close price, targeting deviations above 2.0 standard deviations to capture potential overextension reversals.
rationale: Large deviations in the 50-period Z-score of the closing price suggest a statistical overextension that historically precedes a mean-reverting move, consistent with statistical arbitrage principles for crypto assets.
